motion_system: Keep the suspended field still. Focus may lift only the existing edge of the selected fold slightly and deepen its cavity shadow; reduced motion preserves the static plate.
color_drift: None; maintain discontinuous green and rust-orange patches against exposed gray-beige folds and a cool luminous field.
glow_behavior: Backlit ridges only, with one localized reflective glint; no emissive halos or hotspot glow.
